Flounder Fillet

About This Entry

Flounder fillet is thin, mild flatfish — stuffing and rolling are common. Light whites with citrus and herb notes match simple preparations.

Beginner Guide

Summer flounder is a common US Atlantic species in this entry.

FAQ

What is Flounder Fillet?
Summer flounder is a common US Atlantic species in this entry.
How should Flounder Fillet be cooked for best results?
Do not overcook lean fillets; shellfish should be opaque and firm. Rest fish briefly before serving.
